audit.whatIsWrong: The knockup is attributed to the wrong ability. The content layer says 'His Q drops a magma pillar that pillar-traps and knocks you up if it pins you to terrain', and wants.you[2] repeats it. Volcanic Rupture does not knock up — it damages, slows and leaves a pillar. The knockup is Searing Charge (E) colliding with terrain, and the pillar his own Q just made is that terrain.
audit.why: enemyKit Q: 'sends out a fissure dealing damage and slowing enemies hit. After a small delay, a magma pillar forms at the end location', cd 9/8.5/8/7.5/7. enemyKit E: 'If Ornn collides with terrain while charging, the impact creates a shockwave around him which deals damage and knocks up enemies', cd 14/13.5/13/12.5/12. Naming the wrong half breaks the advice — the player watches the Q and gets hit by the E.
audit.corrected: The pillar is the setup, the E charge into it is the knockup. Stay off walls AND off the fresh pillar.

audit.whatIsWrong: Four chart rows contradict the packet levelChart and their own why-text: Level 1 is 'Skill' while whys[0] says he out-pokes you; Level 2 is Ornn while whys[1] says 'the trade roughly evens out'; Levels 4-5 is 'Skill' while whys[3] says you can't grind him down; Level 6 is 'Skill' while whys[4] calls it a genuine all-in and 'your strongest window'. Both layers carry all four.
audit.why: packet.levelChart is Ornn / Skill / Ornn / Ornn / Gragas / Ornn / Ornn. Mechanically: Ornn's Q is a 9s rank-1 poke against a level-1 Gragas with no Happy Hour trigger; level 6 is the single Gragas row because a 100s Explosive Cask plus the Body Slam stun is a kill threat before he forges his first item.
audit.corrected: win[0] to Ornn, win[1] to Skill, win[3] to Ornn, win[4] to Gragas; phases[0].side to Ornn, phases[1].side to Skill, phases[3].side to Ornn, phases[4].side to Gragas, with ratings and why-text moved with them.

audit.why: EVEN at 6/10 is generous against a 46.64% win rate but the shape the content layer describes is right: he owns the poke phase, Gragas gets exactly level 6, and the Living Forge item lead takes it back for good.
No patch-driven claim on the page depends on 26.16 content; the item names cited (Riftmaker, Frostfire Gauntlet, Heartsteel) are all live on 26.15.

edits.before: Ornn out-pokes you here and you can't kill a tank with one combo, so respect levels 1-3. His Q drops a magma pillar that pillar-traps and knocks you up if it pins you to terrain, and his W (Bellows Breath) channels through your damage and applies Brittle — his next auto on a Brittle target detonates it for bonus damage and a slow. Don't fight near walls, and don't trade into his W channel; last-hit at range, detonate your Q early just to chip him and keep Happy Hour healing, and accept that your Drunken Rage max isn't online yet so your sustain trade is weak.
edits.after: Ornn out-pokes you here and you can't kill a tank with one combo, so respect levels 1-3. His Q leaves a magma pillar on a 9s cooldown, and it is his E charge slamming into that pillar — or any wall — that knocks you up, while his W (Bellows Breath) channels through your damage and applies Brittle for a harder follow-up hit and a slow. Don't fight near walls or a fresh pillar, and don't trade into his W channel; last-hit at range, detonate your Q early to chip him and keep Happy Hour healing, and accept that your Drunken Rage max isn't online yet.

notes: The suspectName flag on 'His Living Forge' is a false positive — that is Ornn's real passive name and it is used correctly. The genuine ability error was the knockup being credited to Q instead of the E charge, which is exactly backwards for a player trying to dodge it. UNVERIFIED and left in place: the page states Brittle is 'detonated' by Ornn's next auto for bonus damage and a slow. Riot's kit text only says enemies 'become Brittle' and never describes the consumption rule, so I could not confirm the detonation wording from the kits and did not touch it — it is not in a field I edited. Same for the claim that Ornn's forged items cost no gold on boots.
